Jesus, on sale big time. I need to read up on it a little bit today and then grab it. I need something that can show me different metals so i stop wasting my time on the MILLIONS of old nails in the ground here.

I go through phases...sometimes it's nice to just leave it on all metal, because you never know what you'll miss. Other times i just want to hunt for coins or something and it's hard with this Tracker IV

I bought a cheap Bounty Hunter IV detector from amazon a few years ago, it works well but i'm thinking about upgrading to something with a display so i can pick out different metals without digging.

I did invest in a Garret Propointer eariler this year. I think it cost more than my detector but it's soooo worth it, especially if you have a ton of metal in the ground. Shaves so much time off of the process.

I have a Garrett Ace 350, the lowest end model that comes with the double D coil. I also run with a Garrett pin pointer. My diggers are both made by Fiskars. The main digger has saw teeth on one edge and is perfect for starting holes. I also where knee pads and carry a satchel to hold my finds. These days I've been wearing a GoPro to make and share videos. I may post a link to my channel soon.
